svg.title: Trace from OpenTelemetry instrumentations
svg.desc: POST /run contains invoke_workflow diagnose_workload. Chat spans are collapsed, hiding the HTTP client span under each. The inspect_workload tool runs the diagnostic agent. The consult_runbook tool's HTTP client span stays expanded: the runbook service's server, workflow, and chat spans sit under it in the same trace. Names and nesting follow trace 36834b4c2a254ac26e29cecc1976d634 from the demo with OpenTelemetry instrumentations. Bar positions follow the matching spans of the slide 5 capture on the same 0 to 0.7 second axis. The HTTP client span is labeled POST 200. Blue identifies diagnostic-agent spans; amber identifies runbook spans.
